text.brief: A governor's trade office signs a memorandum in 2030 with a mainland province covering agriculture, education and "smart city" data. The province's partner office sits inside the United Front Work Department.
text.record: The Justice Department charged a former aide to two New York governors in September 2024 with acting as an undisclosed agent of the People's Republic ([Indictment, United States v. Sun and Hu (E.D.N.Y. 24-cr-346)](https://www.justice.gov/d9/2024-09/sun_and_hu_indictment.pdf); [CourtListener docket, United States v. Sun](https://www.courtlistener.com/docket/69124149/united-states-v-sun/)). The United Front Work Department runs the Party's outreach to foreign officials and communities. State governments carry no general duty to register agents of foreign principals.
text.reading: The Party courts the parts of American government that federal law watches least. Trade missions, donations and sister-state pacts build friends inside governors' offices, and over time the friends shape decisions from inside. This is Stratagem 25, replace the beams with rotten timbers.
text.coreEvent: A state official faces charges for acting as an undisclosed agent of the People's Republic before 2034.
text.gapText: Architecture Governance. Federal law registers foreign agents in Washington and stops at the statehouse door.
text.fix: Extend disclosure to state government and publish every foreign memorandum. Sunlight works better than bans.
